known_issues: Grid & List view toggle in 'My Files' section does not switch the file display layout when clicked

existing_features.title: Fix the Grid & List view toggle in the 'My Files' (Dashboard/FileList) section so that clicking the grid or list view icon in the FileToolbar actually switches the file display area between grid layout and list layout. The viewMode state must be correctly initialized, passed down from the parent (Dashboard or FileList), and consumed by the file rendering logic to apply the correct layout.

projectName: Fix Grid & List view toggle in My Files section
